BitField.description: Timer0 Counter Value\nThis field indicates the internal Timer0 counter values.\nNote: Unit of Timer0 counter is ETU base.
BitField.name: CNT

BitField.description: Timer0 Operation Mode Selection\nThis field indicates the internal 24-bit Timer0 operation selection.\nRefer to Table 6.253 for programming Timer0.
BitField.name: OPMODE

BitField.description: SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)\nDue to synchronization, user should check this bit when writing a new value to the SCn_TMRCTL0 register.
BitField.name: SYNC

BitField.description: Timer 1 Counter Value\nThis field indicates the internal Timer1 counter values. \nNote: Unit of Timer1 counter is ETU base.
BitField.name: CNT

BitField.description: Timer 1 Operation Mode Selection\nThis field indicates the internal 8-bit Timer1 operation selection.\nRefer to Table 6.253 for programming Timer1.
BitField.name: OPMODE

BitField.description: SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)\nDue to synchronization, software should check this bit when writing a new value to SCn_TMRCTL1 register.
BitField.name: SYNC

BitField.description: Timer 2 Counter Value\nThis field indicates the internal Timer2 counter values. \nNote: Unit of Timer2 counter is ETU base.
BitField.name: CNT

BitField.description: Timer 2 Operation Mode Selection\nThis field indicates the internal 8-bit Timer2 operation selection\nRefer to Table 6.253 for programming Timer2.
BitField.name: OPMODE

BitField.description: SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)\nDue to synchronization, user should check this bit when writing a new value to SCn_TMRCTL2 register.
BitField.name: SYNC

BitField.description: UART Mode Enable Bit\nSet this bit to enable UART mode function.\nNote 3: When UART mode is enabled, hardware will generate a reset to reset FIFO and internal state machine.
BitField.name: UARTEN

BitField.description: Word Length Selection\nThis field is used for select UART data length.\nNote: In smart card mode, this WLS must be 00.
BitField.name: WLS

BitField.description: Parity Bit Disable Bit\nThis bit is used for disable parity check function.\nNote: In smart card mode, this field must be 0 (default setting is with parity bit).
BitField.name: PBOFF

BitField.description: Odd Parity Enable Bit\nThis is used for odd/even parity selection.\nNote: This bit has effect only when PBOFF bit is 0.
BitField.name: OPE

BitField.description:
T1 Extend Time of Hardware Activation
This field provide the configurable cycles to extend the activation time T1 period.
The cycle scaling factor is 2048.
Note: Setting 0 to this field conforms to the protocol ISO/IEC 7816-3
BitField.name: T1EXT

BitField.description:
Receive/Transmit Holding Buffer
Write Operation:
By writing data to DAT, the SC will send out an 8-bit data.
Read Operation:
By reading DAT, the SC will return an 8-bit received data.
Note: If SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) is not enabled, DAT cannot be programmed.
BitField.name: DAT

BitField.description: SC Controller Enable Bit\nSet this bit to 1 to enable SC operation. If this bit is cleared, \nNote: SCEN must be set to 1 before filling in other SC registers, or smart card will not work properly.
BitField.name: SCEN

BitField.description: RX Transition Disable Control Bit\nThis bit is used for disable Rx transition function.\nNote: If AUTOCEN (SCn_CTL[3]) is enabled, this field is ignored.
BitField.name: RXOFF

BitField.description: TX Transition Disable Control Bit\nThis bit is used for disable Tx transition function.
BitField.name: TXOFF

BitField.description:
Auto Convention Enable Bit
This bit is used for enable auto convention function.
Note 1: If user enables auto convention function, the setting step must be done before Answer to Reset (ATR) state and the first data must be 0x3B or 0x3F. After hardware received first data and stored it at buffer, hardware will decided the convention and change the CONSEL (SCn_CTL[5:4]) bits automatically when received first data is 0x3B or 0x3F. If received first byte is 0x3B, TS is direct convention, CONSEL (SCn_CTL[5:4]) will be set to 00 automatically, otherwise the TS is inverse convention, and CONSEL (SCn_CTL[5:4]) will be set to 11.
Note 2: If the first data is not 0x3B or 0x3F, hardware will set ACERRIF (SCn_INTSTS[10]) and generate an interrupt to CPU when ACERRIEN (SCn_INTEN[10]) is enabled.
BitField.name: AUTOCEN

BitField.description: Convention Selection\nNote: If AUTOCEN (SCn_CTL[3]) is enabled, this field is ignored.
BitField.name: CONSEL

BitField.description: Rx Buffer Trigger Level \nWhen the number of bytes in the receiving buffer equals the RXTRGLV, the RDAIF will be set. If RDAIEN (SCn_INTEN[0]) is enabled, an interrupt will be generated to CPU.
BitField.name: RXTRGLV

BitField.description: Block Guard Time \nNote: The real block guard time is BGT + 1.
BitField.name: BGT

BitField.description: Timer Channel Selection \nOther configurations are reserved.
BitField.name: TMRSEL

BitField.description:
Stop Bit Length
This field indicates the length of stop bit.
Note 1: The default stop bit length is 2. SC and UART adopts NSB to program the stop bit length. 
Note 2: In UART mode, RX can receive the data sequence in 1 stop bit or 2 stop bits with NSB is set to 0.
BitField.name: NSB

BitField.description:
RX Error Retry Count Number
This field indicates the maximum number of receiver retries that are allowed when parity error has occurred
Note 1: The real retry number is RXRTY + 1, so 8 is the maximum retry number.
Note 2: This field cannot be changed when RXRTYEN enabled. The change flow is to disable RXRTYEN first and then fill in new retry value.
BitField.name: RXRTY

BitField.description: RX Error Retry Enable Bit\nThis bit enables receiver retry function when parity error has occurred.\nNote: User must fill in the RXRTY value before enabling this bit.
BitField.name: RXRTYEN

BitField.description:
TX Error Retry Count Number
This field indicates the maximum number of transmitter retries that are allowed when parity error has occurred.
Note 1: The real retry number is TXRTY + 1, so 8 is the maximum retry number.
Note 2: This field cannot be changed when TXRTYEN enabled. The change flow is to disable TXRTYEN first and then fill in new retry value.
BitField.name: TXRTY

BitField.description: TX Error Retry Enable Bit\nThis bit enables transmitter retry function when parity error has occurred.
BitField.name: TXRTYEN

BitField.description: Card Detect De-bounce Selection\nThis field indicates the card detect de-bounce selection.\nOther configurations are reserved.
BitField.name: CDDBSEL

BitField.description: Card Detect Level Selection \nNote: User must select card detect level before Smart Card controller enabled.
BitField.name: CDLV

BitField.description: SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)\nDue to synchronization, user should check this bit before writing a new value to RXRTY and TXRTY fields.
BitField.name: SYNC

BitField.description: TX Software Reset\nWhen TXRST is set, all the bytes in the transmit buffer and TX internal state machine will be cleared.\nNote: This bit will be auto cleared after reset is complete.
BitField.name: TXRST

BitField.description: Rx Software Reset\nWhen RXRST is set, all the bytes in the receive buffer and Rx internal state machine will be cleared.\nNote: This bit will be auto cleared after reset is complete.
BitField.name: RXRST

BitField.description:
Deactivation Sequence Generator Enable Bit
This bit enables SC controller to initiate the card by deactivation sequence.
Note 1: When the deactivation sequence completed, this bit will be cleared automatically and the INITIF (SCn_INTSTS[8]) will be set to 1.
Note 2: This field will be cleared by TXRST (SCn_ALTCTL[0]) and RXRST (SCn_ALTCTL[1]). Thus, do not fill in this bit DACTEN, TXRST and RXRST at the same time.
Note 3: If SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) is not enabled, this filed cannot be programmed.
BitField.name: DACTEN

BitField.description:
Activation Sequence Generator Enable Bit
This bit enables SC controller to initiate the card by activation sequence.
Note 1: When the activation sequence completed, this bit will be cleared automatically and the INITIF (SCn_INTSTS[8]) will be set to 1.
Note 2: This field will be cleared by TXRST (SCn_ALTCTL[0]) and RXRST (SCn_ALTCTL[1]). Thus, do not fill in this bit ACTEN, TXRST and RXRST at the same time.
Note 3: If SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) is not enabled, this filed cannot be programmed.
Note 4: During the activation sequence, RX is disabled automatically and cannot receive data. After the activation sequence completion, RXOFF (SCn_CTL[1]) keeps the state before hardware activation.
BitField.name: ACTEN

BitField.description:
Warm Reset Sequence Generator Enable Bit
This bit enables SC controller to initiate the card by warm reset sequence.
Note 1: When the warm reset sequence completed, this bit will be cleared automatically and the INITIF (SCn_INTSTS[8]) will be set to 1.
Note 2: This field will be cleared by TXRST (SCn_ALTCTL[0]) and RXRST (SCn_ALTCTL[1]). Thus, do not fill in this bit WARSTEN, TXRST and RXRST at the same time.
Note 3: If SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) is not enabled, this filed cannot be programmed.
Note 4: During the warm reset sequence, RX is disabled automatically and cannot receive data. After the warm reset sequence completion, RXOFF (SCn_CTL[1]) keeps the state before perform warm reset sequence.
BitField.name: WARSTEN

BitField.description: Internal Timer0 Start Enable Bit\nThis bit enables Timer 0 to start counting. User can fill 0 to stop it and set 1 to reload and count. The counter unit is ETU base.\nNote 3: If SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) is not enabled, this filed cannot be programmed.
BitField.name: CNTEN0

BitField.description: Internal Timer1 Start Enable Bit\nThis bit enables Timer 1 to start counting. User can fill 0 to stop it and set 1 to reload and count. The counter unit is ETU base.\nNote 3: If SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) is not enabled, this filed cannot be programmed.
BitField.name: CNTEN1

BitField.description: Internal Timer2 Start Enable Bit\nThis bit enables Timer 2 to start counting. User can fill 0 to stop it and set 1 to reload and count. The counter unit is ETU base.\nNote 3: If SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) is not enabled, this filed cannot be programmed.
BitField.name: CNTEN2

BitField.description:
Initial Timing Selection
This fields indicates the initial timing of hardware activation, warm-reset or deactivation.
The unit of initial timing is SC module clock.
Activation: refer to SC Activation Sequence in Figure 6.254.
Warm-reset: refer to Warm-Reset Sequence in Figure 6.255.
Deactivation: refer to Deactivation Sequence in Figure 6.256.
Note: When set activation and warm reset in Timer0 operation mode 0011, it may have deviation at most 128 SC module clock cycles.
BitField.name: INITSEL

BitField.description: Auto Deactivation When Card Removal\nThis bit is used for enable hardware auto deactivation when smart card is removed.\nNote: When the card is removed, hardware will stop any process and then do deactivation sequence if this bit is set. If auto deactivation process completes, hardware will set INITIF (SCn_INTSTS[8]) also.
BitField.name: ADACEN

BitField.description: Receiver Block Guard Time Function Enable Bit\nThis bit enables the receiver block guard time function.
BitField.name: RXBGTEN

BitField.description: Internal Timer0 Active Status (Read Only)\nThis bit indicates the timer counter status of Timer0.\nNote: Timer0 is active does not always mean Timer0 is counting the CNT (SCn_TMRCTL0[23:0]).
BitField.name: ACTSTS0

BitField.description: Internal Timer1 Active Status (Read Only)\nThis bit indicates the timer counter status of Timer1.\nNote: Timer1 is active does not always mean Timer1 is counting the CNT (SCn_TMRCTL1[7:0]).
BitField.name: ACTSTS1

BitField.description: Internal Timer2 Active Status (Read Only)\nThis bit indicates the timer counter status of Timer2.\nNote: Timer2 is active does not always mean Timer2 is counting the CNT (SCn_TMRCTL2[7:0]).
BitField.name: ACTSTS2

BitField.description: SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)\nDue to synchronization, user should check this bit when writing a new value to SCn_ALTCTL register.
BitField.name: SYNC

BitField.description: Extra Guard Time\nThis field indicates the extra guard time value.\nNote: The extra guard time unit is ETU base.
BitField.name: EGT

Register.description: SC Receive Buffer Time-out Counter Register
Register.name: SC_RXTOUT

BitField.description:
SC Receiver FIFO Time-out Counter
The time-out down counter resets and starts counting whenever the RX buffer received a new data. Once the counter decrease to 1 and no new data is received or CPU does not read data by reading SCn_DAT, a receiver time-out flag RXTOIF (SCn_INTSTS[9]) will be set, and hardware will generate an interrupt to CPU when RXTOIEN (SCn_INTEN[9]) is enabled.
Note 1: The counter unit is ETU based and the interval of time-out is RFTM + 0.5.
Note 2: Filling in all 0 to this field indicates to disable this function.
BitField.name: RFTM

Register.description: SC Element Time Unit Control Register
Register.name: SC_ETUCTL

BitField.description:
ETU Rate Divider
The field is used for ETU clock rate divider.
The real ETU is ETURDIV + 1.
Note: User can configure this field, but this field must be greater than 0x04.
BitField.name: ETURDIV

BitField.description: Receive Data Reach Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis field is used to enable received data reaching trigger level RXTRGLV (SCn_CTL[7:6]) interrupt.
BitField.name: RDAIEN

BitField.description: Transmit Buffer Empty Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis field is used to enable transmit buffer empty interrupt.
BitField.name: TBEIEN

BitField.description: Transfer Error Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis field is used to enable transfer error interrupt. The transfer error states is at SCn_STATUS register which includes receiver break error BEF (SCn_STATUS[6]), frame error FEF (SCn_STATUS[5]), parity error PEF (SCn_STATUS[4]), receive buffer overflow error RXOV (SCn_STATUS[0]), transmit buffer overflow error TXOV (SCn_STATUS[8]), receiver retry over limit error RXOVERR (SCn_STATUS[22]) and transmitter retry over limit error TXOVERR (SCn_STATUS[30]).
BitField.name: TERRIEN

BitField.description: Timer0 Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis field is used to enable Timer0 interrupt function.
BitField.name: TMR0IEN

BitField.description: Timer1 Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis field is used to enable the Timer1 interrupt function.
BitField.name: TMR1IEN

BitField.description: Timer2 Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis field is used to enable Timer2 interrupt function.
BitField.name: TMR2IEN

BitField.description: Block Guard Time Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis field is used to enable block guard time interrupt in receive direction.\nNote: This bit is valid only for receive direction block guard time.
BitField.name: BGTIEN

BitField.description: Card Detect Interrupt Enable Bit\nThis field is used to enable card detect interrupt. The card detect status is CDPINSTS (SCn_STATUS[13]).
BitField.name: CDIEN

BitField.description: Initial End Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: INITIEN

BitField.description: Receiver Buffer Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit \nThis field is used to enable receiver buffer time-out interrupt.
BitField.name: RXTOIEN

BitField.description: Auto Convention Error Interrupt Enable Bit \nThis field is used to enable auto-convention error interrupt.
BitField.name: ACERRIEN

BitField.description: Receive Data Reach Interrupt Status Flag (Read Only)\nThis field is used for received data reaching trigger level RXTRGLV (SCn_CTL[7:6]) interrupt status flag.\nNote: This bit is read only. If user reads data from SCn_DAT and receiver buffer data byte number is less than RXTRGLV, this bit will be cleared automatically.
BitField.name: RDAIF

BitField.description: Transmit Buffer Empty Interrupt Status Flag (Read Only)\nThis field is used for transmit buffer empty interrupt status flag.\nNote: This bit is read only. If user wants to clear this bit, user must write data to DAT (SCn_DAT[7:0]) and then this bit will be cleared automatically.
BitField.name: TBEIF

BitField.description:
Transfer Error Interrupt Status Flag
This field is used for transfer error interrupt status flag. The transfer error states is at SCn_STATUS register which includes receiver break error BEF (SCn_STATUS[6]), frame error FEF (SCn_STATUS[5], parity error PEF (SCn_STATUS[4] and receive buffer overflow error RXOV (SCn_STATUS[0]), transmit buffer overflow error TXOV (SCn_STATUS[8]), receiver retry over limit error RXOVERR (SCn_STATUS[22] or transmitter retry over limit error TXOVERR (SCn_STATUS[30]).
Note 1: This field is the status flag of BEF, FEF, PEF, RXOV, TXOV, RXOVERR or TXOVERR.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: TERRIF

BitField.description: Timer0 Interrupt Status Flag\nThis field is used for Timer0 interrupt status flag.\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: TMR0IF

BitField.description: Timer1 Interrupt Status Flag\nThis field is used for Timer1 interrupt status flag.\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: TMR1IF

BitField.description: Timer2 Interrupt Status Flag\nThis field is used for Timer2 interrupt status flag.\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: TMR2IF

BitField.description:
Block Guard Time Interrupt Status Flag
This field is used for indicate block guard time interrupt status flag in receive direction.
Note 1: This bit is valid only when RXBGTEN (SCn_ALTCTL[12]) is enabled.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: BGTIF

BitField.description: Card Detect Interrupt Status Flag (Read Only)\nThis field is used for card detect interrupt status flag. The card detect status is CINSERT (SCn_STATUS[12]) and CREMOVE (SCn_STATUS[11]).\nNote: This bit is read only, user must to clear CINSERT or CREMOVE status to clear it.
BitField.name: CDIF

BitField.description: Initial End Interrupt Status Flag\nThis field is used for activation (ACTEN (SCn_ALTCTL[3])), deactivation (DACTEN (SCn_ALTCTL[2])) and warm reset (WARSTEN (SCn_ALTCTL[4])) sequence interrupt status flag.\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: INITIF

BitField.description: Receive Buffer Time-out Interrupt Status Flag (Read Only)\nThis field is used for indicate receive buffer time-out interrupt status flag.\nNote: This bit is read only, user must read all receive buffer remaining data by reading SCn_DAT register to clear it.
BitField.name: RXTOIF

BitField.description: Auto Convention Error Interrupt Status Flag\nThis field indicates auto convention sequence error.\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: ACERRIF

BitField.description: Receive Overflow Error Status Flag \nThis bit is set when Rx buffer overflow.\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: RXOV

BitField.description: Receive Buffer Empty Status Flag (Read Only)\nThis bit indicates Rx buffer empty or not.
BitField.name: RXEMPTY

BitField.description: Receive Buffer Full Status Flag (Read Only)\nThis bit indicates Rx buffer full or not.
BitField.name: RXFULL

BitField.description:
Receiver Parity Error Status Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid parity bit.
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: If CPU sets receiver retries function by setting RXRTYEN (SCn_CTL[19]), hardware will not set this flag.
BitField.name: PEF

BitField.description:
Receiver Frame Error Status Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid stop bit (that is, the stop bit following the last data bit or parity bit is detected as logic 0). 
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: If CPU sets receiver retries function by setting RXRTYEN (SCn_CTL[19]), hardware will not set this flag.
BitField.name: FEF

BitField.description:
Receiver Break Error Status Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received data input (Rx) held in the spacing state (logic 0) is longer than a full word transmission time (that is, the total time of 'start bit' + 'data bits' + 'parity bit' + 'stop bits').
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: If CPU sets receiver retries function by setting RXRTYEN (SCn_CTL[19]), hardware will not set this flag.
BitField.name: BEF

BitField.description: Transmit Overflow Error Interrupt Status Flag\nThis bit is set when Tx buffer overflow. \nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: TXOV

BitField.description: Transmit Buffer Empty Status Flag (Read Only)\nThis bit indicates TX buffer empty or not.\nNote: This bit will be cleared when writing data into DAT (SCn_DAT[7:0]).
BitField.name: TXEMPTY

BitField.description: Transmit Buffer Full Status Flag (Read Only)\nThis bit indicates Tx buffer full or not.
BitField.name: TXFULL

BitField.description:
Card Removal Status of SCn_CD Pin
This bit is set whenever card has been removal.
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
Note 2: Card detect function will start after SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) set.
BitField.name: CREMOVE

BitField.description:
Card Insert Status of SCn_CD Pin
This bit is set whenever card has been inserted.
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
Note 2: The card detect function will start after SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) set.
BitField.name: CINSERT

BitField.description: Card Detect Pin Status (Read Only)\nThis bit is the pin status of SCn_CD.
BitField.name: CDPINSTS

BitField.description: Receive Buffer Pointer Status (Read Only)\nThis field indicates the Rx buffer pointer status. When SC controller receives one byte from external device, RXPOINT increases one. When one byte of Rx buffer is read by CPU, RXPOINT decreases one.
BitField.name: RXPOINT

BitField.description:
Receiver Retry Error
This bit is used for receiver error retry and set by hardware.
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: This bit is a flag and cannot generate any interrupt to CPU.
Note 3: If CPU enables receiver retries function by setting RXRTYEN (SCn_CTL[19]), hardware will not set this flag.
BitField.name: RXRERR

BitField.description:
Receiver over Retry Error
This bit is used for receiver retry counts over than retry number limitation.
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: If CPU enables receiver retries function by setting RXRTYEN (SCn_CTL[19]), hardware will not set this flag.
BitField.name: RXOVERR

BitField.description: Receiver in Active Status Flag (Read Only)\nThis bit indicates Rx transfer status.
BitField.name: RXACT

BitField.description: Transmit Buffer Pointer Status (Read Only)\nThis field indicates the Tx buffer pointer status. When CPU writes data into SCn_DAT, TXPOINT increases one. When one byte of Tx buffer is transferred to transmitter shift register, TXPOINT decreases one.
BitField.name: TXPOINT

BitField.description:
Transmitter Retry Error
This bit is used for indicate transmitter error retry and set by hardware.
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: This bit is a flag and cannot generate any interrupt to CPU.
BitField.name: TXRERR

BitField.description: Transmitter over Retry Error\nThis bit is used for transmitter retry counts over than retry number limitation.\nNote: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: TXOVERR

BitField.description: Transmit in Active Status Flag (Read Only)\nThis bit indicates Tx transmit status.
BitField.name: TXACT

BitField.description:
SCn_PWR Pin Signal
User can set PWRINV (SCn_PINCTL[11]) and PWREN (SCn_PINCTL[0]) to decide SCn_PWR pin is in high or low level.
Write this field to drive SCn_PWR pin.
Refer PWRINV (SCn_PINCTL[11]) description for programming SCn_PWR pin voltage level. 
Read this field to get SCn_PWR signal status.
Note: When operating at activation, warm reset or deactivation mode, this bit will be changed automatically. Thus, do not fill in this field when operating in these modes.
BitField.name: PWREN

BitField.description:
SCn_RST Pin Signal
User can set RSTEN (SCn_PINCTL[1]) to decide SCn_RST pin is in high or low level.
Write this field to drive SCn_RST pin.
Note: When operating at activation, warm reset or deactivation mode, this bit will be changed automatically. Thus, do not fill in this field when operating in these modes.
BitField.name: RSTEN

BitField.description: SC Clock Enable Bit \nNote: When operating in activation, warm reset or deactivation mode, this bit will be changed automatically. Thus, do not fill in this field when operating in these modes.
BitField.name: CLKKEEP

BitField.description: SCn_DATA Pin Signal \nThis bit is the signal status of SCn_DATA but user can drive SCn_DATA pin to high or low by setting this bit.\nNote: When SC is at activation, warm reset or deactivation mode, this bit will be changed automatically. Thus, do not fill in this field when SC is in these modes.
BitField.name: SCDATA

BitField.description:
SCn_PWR Pin Inverse
This bit is used for inverse the SCn_PWR pin.
There are four kinds of combination for SCn_PWR pin setting by PWRINV (SCn_PINCTL[11]) and PWREN (SCn_PINCTL[0]). 
PWRINV (SCn_PINCTL[11]) is bit 1 and PWREN (SCn_PINCTL[0]) is bit 0 and all conditions as below list, 
Note: User must select PWRINV (SCn_PINCTL[11]) before smart card is enabled by SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]).
BitField.name: PWRINV

BitField.description: SCn_DATA Pin Status (Read Only)\nThis bit is the pin status of SCn_DATA.
BitField.name: DATASTS

BitField.description: SCn_PWR Pin Status (Read Only)\nThis bit is the pin status of SCn_PWR.
BitField.name: PWRSTS

BitField.description: SCn_RST Pin Status (Read Only)\nThis bit is the pin status of SCn_RST.
BitField.name: RSTSTS

BitField.description: SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)\nDue to synchronization, user should check this bit when writing a new value to SCn_PINCTL register.
BitField.name: SYNC

BitField.description: Timer0 Counter Value\nThis field indicates the internal Timer0 counter values.\nNote: Unit of Timer0 counter is ETU base.
BitField.name: CNT

BitField.description: Timer0 Operation Mode Selection\nThis field indicates the internal 24-bit Timer0 operation selection.\nRefer to Table 6.253 for programming Timer0.
BitField.name: OPMODE

BitField.description: SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)\nDue to synchronization, user should check this bit when writing a new value to the SCn_TMRCTL0 register.
BitField.name: SYNC

BitField.description: Timer 1 Counter Value\nThis field indicates the internal Timer1 counter values. \nNote: Unit of Timer1 counter is ETU base.
BitField.name: CNT

BitField.description: Timer 1 Operation Mode Selection\nThis field indicates the internal 8-bit Timer1 operation selection.\nRefer to Table 6.253 for programming Timer1.
BitField.name: OPMODE

BitField.description: SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)\nDue to synchronization, software should check this bit when writing a new value to SCn_TMRCTL1 register.
BitField.name: SYNC

BitField.description: Timer 2 Counter Value\nThis field indicates the internal Timer2 counter values. \nNote: Unit of Timer2 counter is ETU base.
BitField.name: CNT

BitField.description: Timer 2 Operation Mode Selection\nThis field indicates the internal 8-bit Timer2 operation selection\nRefer to Table 6.253 for programming Timer2.
BitField.name: OPMODE

BitField.description: SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)\nDue to synchronization, user should check this bit when writing a new value to SCn_TMRCTL2 register.
BitField.name: SYNC

BitField.description: UART Mode Enable Bit\nSet this bit to enable UART mode function.\nNote 3: When UART mode is enabled, hardware will generate a reset to reset FIFO and internal state machine.
BitField.name: UARTEN

BitField.description: Word Length Selection\nThis field is used for select UART data length.\nNote: In smart card mode, this WLS must be 00.
BitField.name: WLS

BitField.description: Parity Bit Disable Bit\nThis bit is used for disable parity check function.\nNote: In smart card mode, this field must be 0 (default setting is with parity bit).
BitField.name: PBOFF

BitField.description: Odd Parity Enable Bit\nThis is used for odd/even parity selection.\nNote: This bit has effect only when PBOFF bit is 0.
BitField.name: OPE

BitField.description:
T1 Extend Time of Hardware Activation
This field provide the configurable cycles to extend the activation time T1 period.
The cycle scaling factor is 2048.
Note: Setting 0 to this field conforms to the protocol ISO/IEC 7816-3
BitField.name: T1EXT

BitField.description: I2S Controller Enable Bit
BitField.name: I2SEN

BitField.description: Transmit Enable Bit
BitField.name: TXEN

BitField.description: Receive Enable Bit
BitField.name: RXEN

BitField.description: Transmit Mute Enable Bit
BitField.name: MUTE

BitField.description: Data Width\nThis bit field is used to define the bit-width of data word in each audio channel
BitField.name: DATWIDTH

BitField.description: Monaural Data Control\nNote: When chip records data, RXLCH (I2S_CTL0[23]) indicates which channel data will be saved if monaural format is selected.
BitField.name: MONO

BitField.description: Stereo Data Order in FIFO\nIn 8-bit/16-bit data width, this bit is used to select whether the even or odd channel data is stored in higher byte. In 24-bit data width, this is used to select the left/right alignment method of audio data which is stored in data memory consisted of 32-bit FIFO entries.\nMSB of 24-bit audio data in each channel is aligned to left side in 32-bit FIFO entries.
BitField.name: ORDER

BitField.description: Slave Mode Enable Bit\nNote: I2S can operate as master or slave. For Master mode, I2S_BCLK and I2S_LRCLK pins are output mode and send out bit clock to Audio CODEC chip. In Slave mode, I2S_BCLK and I2S_LRCLK pins are input mode and I2S_BCLK and I2S_LRCLK signals are received from outer Audio CODEC chip.
BitField.name: SLAVE

BitField.description: Master Clock Enable Bit\nIf MCLKEN is set to 1, I2S controller will generate master clock on I2S_MCLK pin for external audio devices.
BitField.name: MCLKEN

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Buffer Clear\nNote 1: Write 1 to clear transmit FIFO, internal pointer is reset to FIFO start point, and TXCNT (I2S_STATUS1[12:8]) returns 0 and transmit FIFO becomes empty but data in transmit FIFO is not changed. \nNote 2: This bit is clear by hardware automatically, read it return 0.
BitField.name: TXFBCLR

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Buffer Clear\nNote 1: Write 1 to clear receive FIFO, internal pointer is reset to FIFO start point, and RXCNT (I2S_STATUS1[20:16]) returns 0 and receive FIFO becomes empty.\nNote 2: This bit is cleared by hardware automatically, read it return 0.
BitField.name: RXFBCLR

BitField.description: Transmit PDMA Enable Bit
BitField.name: TXPDMAEN

BitField.description: Receive PDMA Enable Bit
BitField.name: RXPDMAEN

BitField.description: Receive Left Channel Enable Bit
BitField.name: RXLCH

BitField.description: Data Format Selection
BitField.name: FORMAT

BitField.description: PCM Synchronization Pulse Length Selection\nThis bit field is used to select the high pulse length of frame synchronization signal in PCM protocol\nNote: This bit is only available in master mode
BitField.name: PCMSYNC

BitField.description: Channel Width\nThis bit fields are used to define the length of audio channel. If CHWIDTH DATWIDTH, the hardware will set the real channel length as the bit-width of audio data which is defined by DATWIDTH.
BitField.name: CHWIDTH

BitField.description: TDM Channel Number
BitField.name: TDMCHNUM

BitField.description: Master Clock Divider\nIf chip external crystal frequency is (2xMCLKDIV)*256fs then software can program these bits to generate 256fs clock frequency to audio codec chip. If MCLKDIV is set to 0, MCLK is the same as external clock input.\nNote: F_MCLK is the frequency of MCLK, and F_I2SCLK is the frequency of the I2S_CLK
BitField.name: MCLKDIV

BitField.description: Bit Clock Divider\nThe I2S controller will generate bit clock in Master mode. Software can program these bit fields to generate sampling rate clock frequency.\nNote: F_BCLK is the frequency of BCLK and F_I2SCLK is the frequency of I2S_CLK
BitField.name: BCLKDIV

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Underflow Interrupt Enable Bit\nNote: If software reads receive FIFO when it is empty then RXUDIF (I2S_STATUS0[8]) flag is set to 1. If RXUDFIEN bit is enabled, interrupt occurs.
BitField.name: RXUDFIEN

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Overflow Interrupt Enable Bit\nNote: Interrupt occurs if this bit is set to 1 and RXOVIF (I2S_STATUS0[9]) flag is set to 1
BitField.name: RXOVFIEN

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Threshold Level Interrupt Enable Bit\nNote: Interrupt occurs if this bit is set to 1 and data words in receive FIFO is larger than RXTH (I2S_CTL1[19:16]).
BitField.name: RXTHIEN

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Underflow Interrupt Enable Bit\nNote: Interrupt occur if this bit is set to 1 and TXUDIF (I2S_STATUS0[16]) flag is set to 1.
BitField.name: TXUDFIEN

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Overflow Interrupt Enable Bit\nNote: Interrupt occurs if this bit is set to 1 and TXOVIF (I2S_STATUS0[17]) flag is set to 1
BitField.name: TXOVFIEN

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Threshold Level Interrupt Enable Bit\nNote: Interrupt occurs if this bit is set to 1 and data words in transmit FIFO is less than or equal to TXTH (I2S_CTL1[11:8]).
BitField.name: TXTHIEN

BitField.description: Channel0 Zero-cross Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: CH0ZCIEN

BitField.description: Channel1 Zero-cross Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: CH1ZCIEN

BitField.description: Channel2 Zero-cross Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: CH2ZCIEN

BitField.description: Channel3 Zero-cross Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: CH3ZCIEN

BitField.description: Channel4 Zero-cross Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: CH4ZCIEN

BitField.description: Channel5 Zero-cross Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: CH5ZCIEN

BitField.description: Channel6 Zero-cross Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: CH6ZCIEN

BitField.description: Channel7 Zero-cross Interrupt Enable Bit
BitField.name: CH7ZCIEN

BitField.description: I2S Interrupt Flag (Read Only)\nNote: It is wire-OR of I2STXINT and I2SRXINT bits.
BitField.name: I2SINT

BitField.description: I2S Receive Interrupt (Read Only)
BitField.name: I2SRXINT

BitField.description: I2S Transmit Interrupt (Read Only)
BitField.name: I2STXINT

BitField.description: Transmission Data Channel (Read Only)\nThis bit fields are used to indicate which audio channel is current transmit data belong.
BitField.name: DATACH

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Underflow Interrupt Flag\nNote 1: When receive FIFO is empty, and software reads the receive FIFO again. This bit will be set to 1, and it indicates underflow situation occurs.\nNote 2: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0
BitField.name: RXUDIF

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Overflow Interrupt Flag\nNote 1: When receive FIFO is full and receive hardware attempt to write data into receive FIFO then this bit is set to 1, data in 1st buffer is overwritten.\nNote 2: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.
BitField.name: RXOVIF

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Threshold Interrupt Flag (Read Only)\nNote: When data word(s) in receive FIFO is larger than threshold value set in RXTH (I2S_CTL1[19:16]) the RXTHIF bit becomes to 1. It keeps at 1 till RXCNT (I2S_STATUS1[20:16]) is less than or equal to RXTH (I2S_CTL1[19:16]) after software read RXFIFO register.
BitField.name: RXTHIF

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Full (Read Only)\nNote: This bit reflects data words number in receive FIFO is 16.
BitField.name: RXFULL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Empty (Read Only)\nNote: This bit reflects data words number in receive FIFO is 0
BitField.name: RXEMPTY

BitField.name: TXUDIF

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Overflow Interrupt Flag\nNote 1: Write data to transmit FIFO when it is full and this bit set to 1\nNote 2: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.
BitField.name: TXOVIF

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Threshold Interrupt Flag (Read Only)\nNote: When data word(s) in transmit FIFO is less than or equal to threshold value set in TXTH (I2S_CTL1[11:8]) the TXTHIF bit becomes to 1. It keeps at 1 till TXCNT (I2S_STATUS1[12:8]) is larger than TXTH (I2S_CTL1[11:8]) after software write TXFIFO register.

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Full (Read Only)\nThis bit reflect data word number in transmit FIFO is 16

BitField.description: Transmit Busy (Read Only)\nNote: This bit is cleared to 0 when all data in transmit FIFO and shift buffer is shifted out. And set to 1 when 1st data is load to shift buffer.

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Bits\nI2S contains 16 words (16x32 bits) data buffer for data receive. Read this register to get data in FIFO. The remaining data word number is indicated by RXCNT (I2S_STATUS1[20:16]).

BitField.name: DATWIDTH

BitField.description: Monaural Data Control\nNote: When chip records data, RXLCH (I2S_CTL0[23]) indicates which channel data will be saved if monaural format is selected.
BitField.name: MONO

BitField.description: Stereo Data Order in FIFO\nIn 8-bit/16-bit data width, this bit is used to select whether the even or odd channel data is stored in higher byte. In 24-bit data width, this is used to select the left/right alignment method of audio data which is stored in data memory consisted of 32-bit FIFO entries.\nMSB of 24-bit audio data in each channel is aligned to left side in 32-bit FIFO entries.
BitField.name: ORDER

BitField.description: Slave Mode Enable Bit\nNote: I2S can operate as master or slave. For Master mode, I2S_BCLK and I2S_LRCLK pins are output mode and send out bit clock to Audio CODEC chip. In Slave mode, I2S_BCLK and I2S_LRCLK pins are input mode and I2S_BCLK and I2S_LRCLK signals are received from outer Audio CODEC chip.
BitField.name: SLAVE

BitField.description: Master Clock Enable Bit\nIf MCLKEN is set to 1, I2S controller will generate master clock on I2S_MCLK pin for external audio devices.
BitField.name: MCLKEN

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Buffer Clear\nNote 1: Write 1 to clear transmit FIFO, internal pointer is reset to FIFO start point, and TXCNT (I2S_STATUS1[12:8]) returns 0 and transmit FIFO becomes empty but data in transmit FIFO is not changed. \nNote 2: This bit is clear by hardware automatically, read it return 0.
BitField.name: TXFBCLR

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Buffer Clear\nNote 1: Write 1 to clear receive FIFO, internal pointer is reset to FIFO start point, and RXCNT (I2S_STATUS1[20:16]) returns 0 and receive FIFO becomes empty.\nNote 2: This bit is cleared by hardware automatically, read it return 0.
BitField.name: RXFBCLR

BitField.description:
Suspend Interval
The four bits provide configurable suspend interval between two successive transmit/receive transaction in a transfer. The definition of the suspend interval is the interval between the last clock edge of the preceding transaction word and the first clock edge of the following transaction word. The default value is 0x3. The period of the suspend interval is obtained according to the following equation. (Master only)
 (SUSPITV[3:0] + 0.5) * period of SPI_CLK clock cycle
Example:
BitField.name: SUSPITV

BitField.description: Data Width\nThis field specifies how many bits can be transmitted/received in one transaction. The minimum bit length is 4 bits and can up to 32 bits.\nNote: This bit field will decide the depth of TX/RX FIFO configuration in SPI mode. Therefore, changing this bit field will clear TX/RX FIFO by hardware automatically.
BitField.name: DWIDTH

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Threshold\nIf the valid data count of the receive FIFO buffer is larger than the RXTH setting, the RXTHIF bit will be set to 1, else the RXTHIF bit will be cleared to 0. The MSB of this bit field is only meaningful while SPI mode 4~16 bits of data length.
BitField.name: RXTH

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Threshold\nIf the valid data count of the transmit FIFO buffer is less than or equal to the TXTH setting, the TXTHIF bit will be set to 1, else the TXTHIF bit will be cleared to 0. The MSB of this bit field is only meaningful while SPI mode 4~16 bits of data length.
BitField.name: TXTH

BitField.description: Busy Status (Read Only)\nNote: By applications, this SPI busy flag should be used with other status registers in SPIx_STATUS such as TXCNT, RXCNT, TXTHIF, TXFULL, TXEMPTY, RXTHIF, RXFULL, RXEMPTY, and UNITIF. Therefore the SPI transfer done events of TX/RX operations can be obtained at correct timing point.
BitField.name: BUSY

BitField.description: Unit Transfer Interrupt Flag\nNote: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: UNITIF

BitField.description: Slave Select Active Interrupt Flag\nNote: Only available in Slave mode. This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: SSACTIF

BitField.description: Slave Select Inactive Interrupt Flag\nNote: Only available in Slave mode. This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: SSINAIF

BitField.description: Slave Select Line Bus Status (Read Only)\nNote: This bit is only available in Slave mode. If SSACTPOL (SPIx_SSCTL[2]) is set 0, and the SSLINE is 1, the SPI slave select is in inactive status.
BitField.name: SSLINE

BitField.description: Slave Mode Bit Count Error Interrupt Flag\nIn Slave mode, when the slave select line goes to inactive state, if bit counter is mismatch with DWIDTH, this interrupt flag will be set to 1.\nNote: If the slave select active but there is no any bus clock input, the SLVBEIF also active when the slave select goes to inactive state. This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: SLVBEIF

BitField.description: Slave Mode TX Under Run Interrupt Flag\nIn Slave mode, if TX underflow event occurs and the slave select line goes to inactive state, this interrupt flag will be set to 1.\nNote: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: SLVURIF

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Buffer Empty Indicator (Read Only)
BitField.name: RXEMPTY

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Buffer Full Indicator (Read Only)
BitField.name: RXFULL

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Threshold Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
BitField.name: RXTHIF

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Overrun Interrupt Flag\nWhen the receive FIFO buffer is full, the follow-up data will be dropped and this bit will be set to 1.\nNote: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: RXOVIF

BitField.description: Receive Time-out Interrupt Flag\nNote: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: RXTOIF

BitField.description: SPI Enable Status (Read Only)\nNote: The SPI peripheral clock is asynchronous with the system clock. In order to make sure the SPI control logic is disabled, this bit indicates the real status of SPI controller.
BitField.name: SPIENSTS

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Buffer Empty Indicator (Read Only)
BitField.name: TXEMPTY

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Buffer Full Indicator (Read Only)
BitField.name: TXFULL

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Threshold Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
BitField.name: TXTHIF

BitField.description:
TX Underflow Interrupt Flag
When the TX underflow event occurs, this bit will be set to 1, the state of data output pin depends on the setting of TXUFPOL.
Note 1: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: If reset slave's transmission circuit when slave selection signal is active, this flag will be set to 1 after 2 peripheral clock cycles + 3 system clock cycles since the reset operation is done.
BitField.name: TXUFIF

BitField.description: TX or RX Reset Status (Read Only)\nNote: Both the reset operations of TXRST and RXRST need 3 system clock cycles + 2 peripheral clock cycles. User can check the status of this bit to monitor the reset function is doing or done.
BitField.name: TXRXRST

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Data Count (Read Only)\nThis bit field indicates the valid data count of receive FIFO buffer.
BitField.name: RXCNT

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Data Count (Read Only)\nThis bit field indicates the valid data count of transmit FIFO buffer.
BitField.name: TXCNT

BitField.description:
Effective Bit Number of Uncompleted RX data
This status register indicates that effective bit number of uncompleted RX data when SLVBERX (SPIx_FIFOCTL[10]) is enabled and RX bit count error event happen in SPI Slave mode. (SPI Slave mode only)
This status register will be fixed to 0x0 when SLVBERX (SPIx_FIFOCTL[10]) is disabled.
Note: This register will be cleared to 0x0 when user writes 0x1 to SLVBEIF (SPIx_STATUS[6]).
BitField.name: SLVBENUM

BitField.description:
Data Transmit Register
The data transmit registers pass through the transmitted data into the 4-level transmit FIFO buffers. The number of valid bits depends on the setting of DWIDTH (SPIx_CTL[12:8]) in SPI mode or WDWIDTH (SPIx_I2SCTL[5:4]) in I2S mode.
In SPI mode, if DWIDTH is set to 0x08, the bits TX[7:0] will be transmitted. If DWIDTH is set to 0x00, the SPI controller will perform a 32-bit transfer.
In I2S mode, if WDWIDTH (SPIx_I2SCTL[5:4]) is set to 0x2, the data width of audio channel is 24-bit and corresponding to TX[23:0]. If WDWIDTH is set as 0x0, 0x1, or 0x3, all bits of this field are valid and referred to the data arrangement in I2S mode FIFO operation section
Note: In Master mode, SPI controller will start to transfer the SPI bus clock after 1 APB clock and 6 peripheral clock cycles after user writes to this register.
BitField.name: TX

BitField.description: Data Receive Register (Read Only)\nThere are 4-level FIFO buffers in this controller. The data receive register holds the data received from SPI data input pin. If the RXEMPTY (SPIx_STATUS[8] or SPIx_I2SSTS[8]) is not set to 1, the receive FIFO buffers can be accessed through software by reading this register.
BitField.name: RX

BitField.description: I2S Controller Enable Bit\nNote 1: If enabling this bit, I2Sx_BCLK will start to output in Master mode.\nNote 2: Before changing the configurations of SPIx_I2SCTL, SPIx_I2SCLK, and SPIx_FIFOCTL registers, user shall clear the I2SEN (SPIx_I2SCTL[0]) and confirm the I2SENSTS (SPIx_I2SSTS[15]) is 0.
BitField.name: I2SEN

BitField.name: MUTE

BitField.name: WDWIDTH

BitField.description: Monaural Data

BitField.description: Stereo Data Order in FIFO
BitField.name: ORDER

BitField.description: Slave Mode\nI2S can operate as master or slave. For Master mode, I2Sx_BCLK and I2Sx_LRCLK pins are output mode and send bit clock from this chip to audio CODEC chip. In Slave mode, I2Sx_BCLK and I2Sx_LRCLK pins are input mode and I2Sx_BCLK and I2Sx_LRCLK signals are received from outer audio CODEC chip.
BitField.name: SLAVE

BitField.description: Master Clock Enable Bit\nIf MCLKEN is set to 1, I2S controller will generate master clock on SPIx_I2SMCLK pin for external audio devices.
BitField.name: MCLKEN

BitField.description: Right Channel Zero Cross Detection Enable Bit\nIf this bit is set to 1, when right channel data sign bit change or next shift data bits are all 0 then RZCIF flag in SPIx_I2SSTS register is set to 1. This function is only available in transmit operation.
BitField.name: RZCEN

BitField.description: Left Channel Zero Cross Detection Enable Bit\nIf this bit is set to 1, when left channel data sign bit changes or next shift data bits are all 0 then LZCIF flag in SPIx_I2SSTS register is set to 1. This function is only available in transmit operation.
BitField.name: LZCEN

BitField.description: Receive Left Channel Enable Bit
BitField.name: RXLCH

BitField.description: Right Channel Zero Cross Interrupt Enable Bit\nInterrupt occurs if this bit is set to 1 and right channel zero cross event occurs.
BitField.name: RZCIEN

BitField.description: Left Channel Zero Cross Interrupt Enable Bit\nInterrupt occurs if this bit is set to 1 and left channel zero cross event occurs.
BitField.name: LZCIEN

BitField.description: Data Format Selection
BitField.name: FORMAT

BitField.description: Bit Number Error Interrupt Enable Bit for Slave Mode\nInterrupt occurs if this bit is set to 1 and bit number error event occurs.
BitField.name: SLVERRIEN

BitField.description:
Master Clock Divider
If MCLKEN is set to 1, I2S controller will generate master clock for external audio devices. The frequency of master clock, fMCLK, is determined by the following expressions:
where
 is the frequency of I2S peripheral clock source, which is defined in the clock control register, CLK_CLKSEL2 or CLK_CLKSEL3. In general, the master clock rate is 256 times sampling clock rate.
BitField.name: MCLKDIV

BitField.description:
Bit Clock Divider
The I2S controller will generate bit clock in Master mode. The clock frequency of bit clock , fBCLK, is determined by the following expression:

where 
 is the frequency of I2S peripheral clock source, which is defined in the clock control register, CLK_CLKSEL2 or CLK_CLKSEL3.
In I2S Slave mode, this field is used to define the frequency of peripheral clock and it's determined by . 
The peripheral clock frequency in I2S Slave mode must be equal to or faster than 6 times of input bit clock.
Note: The time interval must be larger than or equal to 8 peripheral clock cycles between releasing SPI IP software reset and setting this clock divider register.
BitField.name: BCLKDIV

BitField.description: I2S Clock Divider Number Selection for I2S Mode and SPI Mode\nUser sets I2SMODE to set frequency of peripheral clock of I2S mode or SPI mode when BCLKDIV (SPIx_I2SCLK[17:8]) or DIVIDER (SPIx_CLKDIV[8:0]) is set.\nUser needs to set I2SMODE before I2SEN (SPIx_I2SCTL[0]) or SPIEN (SPIx_CTL[0]) is enabled.
BitField.name: I2SMODE

BitField.description: I2S Clock Divider Number Selection for I2S Slave Mode and I2S Master Mode\nUser sets I2SSLAVE to set frequency of peripheral clock of I2S Master mode and I2S Slave mode when BCLKDIV (SPIx_I2SCLK[17:8]) is set.\nI2SSLAVE needs to set before I2SEN (SPIx_I2SCTL[0]) is enabled.
BitField.name: I2SSLAVE

BitField.description:
Suspend Interval
The four bits provide configurable suspend interval between two successive transmit/receive transaction in a transfer. The definition of the suspend interval is the interval between the last clock edge of the preceding transaction word and the first clock edge of the following transaction word. The default value is 0x3. The period of the suspend interval is obtained according to the following equation. (Master only)
 (SUSPITV[3:0] + 0.5) * period of SPI_CLK clock cycle
Example:
BitField.name: SUSPITV

BitField.description: Data Width\nThis field specifies how many bits can be transmitted/received in one transaction. The minimum bit length is 4 bits and can up to 32 bits.\nNote: This bit field will decide the depth of TX/RX FIFO configuration in SPI mode. Therefore, changing this bit field will clear TX/RX FIFO by hardware automatically.
BitField.name: DWIDTH

If MCLKEN is set to 1, I2S controller will generate master clock for external audio devices. The frequency of master clock, fMCLK, is determined by the following expressions:
where
 is the frequency of I2S peripheral clock source, which is defined in the clock control register, CLK_CLKSEL2 or CLK_CLKSEL3. In general, the master clock rate is 256 times sampling clock rate.
BitField.name: MCLKDIV

BitField.description:
Bit Clock Divider
The I2S controller will generate bit clock in Master mode. The clock frequency of bit clock , fBCLK, is determined by the following expression:

where 
 is the frequency of I2S peripheral clock source, which is defined in the clock control register, CLK_CLKSEL2 or CLK_CLKSEL3.
In I2S Slave mode, this field is used to define the frequency of peripheral clock and it's determined by . 
The peripheral clock frequency in I2S Slave mode must be equal to or faster than 6 times of input bit clock.
Note: The time interval must be larger than or equal to 8 peripheral clock cycles between releasing SPI IP software reset and setting this clock divider register.
BitField.name: BCLKDIV

BitField.description: I2S Clock Divider Number Selection for I2S Mode and SPI Mode\nUser sets I2SMODE to set frequency of peripheral clock of I2S mode or SPI mode when BCLKDIV (SPIx_I2SCLK[17:8]) or DIVIDER (SPIx_CLKDIV[8:0]) is set.\nUser needs to set I2SMODE before I2SEN (SPIx_I2SCTL[0]) or SPIEN (SPIx_CTL[0]) is enabled.
BitField.name: I2SMODE

BitField.description: I2S Clock Divider Number Selection for I2S Slave Mode and I2S Master Mode\nUser sets I2SSLAVE to set frequency of peripheral clock of I2S Master mode and I2S Slave mode when BCLKDIV (SPIx_I2SCLK[17:8]) is set.\nI2SSLAVE needs to set before I2SEN (SPIx_I2SCTL[0]) is enabled.
BitField.name: I2SSLAVE

BitField.description: SPI Transfer Control Enable Bit\nIn Master mode, the transfer will start when there is data in the FIFO buffer after this bit is set to 1. In Slave mode, this device is ready to receive data when this bit is set to 1.\nNote: Before changing the configurations of SPIx_CTL, SPIx_CLKDIV, SPIx_SSCTL and SPIx_FIFOCTL registers, user shall clear the SPIEN (SPIx_CTL[0]) and confirm the SPIENSTS (SPIx_STATUS[15]) is 0.

BitField.description:
Suspend Interval
The four bits provide configurable suspend interval between two successive transmit/receive transaction in a transfer. The definition of the suspend interval is the interval between the last clock edge of the preceding transaction word and the first clock edge of the following transaction word. The default value is 0x3. The period of the suspend interval is obtained according to the following equation. (Master only)
 (SUSPITV[3:0] + 0.5) * period of SPI_CLK clock cycle
Example:
BitField.name: SUSPITV

BitField.description: Data Width\nThis field specifies how many bits can be transmitted/received in one transaction. The minimum bit length is 4 bits and can up to 32 bits.\nNote: This bit field will decide the depth of TX/RX FIFO configuration in SPI mode. Therefore, changing this bit field will clear TX/RX FIFO by hardware automatically.
BitField.name: DWIDTH

BitField.description: Send LSB First
BitField.name: LSB

BitField.description: SPI Half-duplex Transfer Enable Bit\nThis bit is used to select full-duplex or half-duplex for SPI transfer. The bit field DATDIR (SPIx_CTL[20]) can be used to set the data direction in half-duplex transfer.
BitField.name: HALFDPX

BitField.description: Receive-only Mode Enable Bit\nThis bit field is only available in Master mode. In receive-only mode, SPI Master will generate SPI bus clock continuously for receiving data bit from SPI slave device and assert the BUSY status.
BitField.name: RXONLY

BitField.description: Byte Reorder Function Enable Bit\nNote: Byte Reorder function is only available if DWIDTH is defined as 16, 24, and 32 bits.

BitField.description: Data Port Direction Control\nThis bit is used to select the data input/output direction in half-duplex transfer and Dual/Quad transfer
BitField.name: DATDIR

User can enable TX PDMA function firstly or enable both functions simultaneously.\nNote 2: In SPI Master mode with full duplex transfer, if both TX and RX PDMA functions are enabled, TX PDMA function cannot be disabled prior to RX PDMA function. User can disable RX PDMA function firstly or disable both functions simultaneously.

BitField.name: RXTHIEN

BitField.name: RXTOIEN

BitField.description:
TX Underflow Data Polarity
Note 1: The TX underflow event occurs if there is no any data in TX FIFO when the slave selection signal is active.
Note 2: This bit should be set as 0 in I2S mode.
Note 3: When TX underflow event occurs, SPIx_MISO pin state will be determined by this setting even though TX FIFO is not empty afterward. Data stored in TX FIFO will be sent through SPIx_MISO pin in the next transfer frame.
BitField.name: TXUFPOL

BitField.description: TX Underflow Interrupt Enable Bit\nWhen TX underflow event occurs in Slave mode, TXUFIF (SPIx_STATUS[19]) will be set to 1. This bit is used to enable the TX underflow interrupt.
BitField.name: TXUFIEN

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Buffer Clear\nNote: The RX shift register will not be cleared.
BitField.name: RXFBCLR

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Buffer Clear\nNote: The TX shift register will not be cleared.
BitField.name: TXFBCLR

BitField.description: RX FIFO Write Data Enable Bit When Slave Mode Bit Count Error\nThis is SPI Slave mode Only.
BitField.name: SLVBERX

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Threshold\nIf the valid data count of the receive FIFO buffer is larger than the RXTH setting, the RXTHIF bit will be set to 1, else the RXTHIF bit will be cleared to 0. The MSB of this bit field is only meaningful while SPI mode 4~16 bits of data length.
BitField.name: RXTH

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Threshold\nIf the valid data count of the transmit FIFO buffer is less than or equal to the TXTH setting, the TXTHIF bit will be set to 1, else the TXTHIF bit will be cleared to 0. The MSB of this bit field is only meaningful while SPI mode 4~16 bits of data length.
BitField.name: TXTH

BitField.description: Busy Status (Read Only)\nNote: By applications, this SPI busy flag should be used with other status registers in SPIx_STATUS such as TXCNT, RXCNT, TXTHIF, TXFULL, TXEMPTY, RXTHIF, RXFULL, RXEMPTY, and UNITIF. Therefore the SPI transfer done events of TX/RX operations can be obtained at correct timing point.
BitField.name: BUSY

BitField.description: Unit Transfer Interrupt Flag\nNote: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: UNITIF

BitField.description: Slave Select Active Interrupt Flag\nNote: Only available in Slave mode. This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: SSACTIF

BitField.description: Slave Select Inactive Interrupt Flag\nNote: Only available in Slave mode. This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: SSINAIF

BitField.description: Slave Select Line Bus Status (Read Only)\nNote: This bit is only available in Slave mode. If SSACTPOL (SPIx_SSCTL[2]) is set 0, and the SSLINE is 1, the SPI slave select is in inactive status.
BitField.name: SSLINE

BitField.description: Slave Mode Bit Count Error Interrupt Flag\nIn Slave mode, when the slave select line goes to inactive state, if bit counter is mismatch with DWIDTH, this interrupt flag will be set to 1.\nNote: If the slave select active but there is no any bus clock input, the SLVBEIF also active when the slave select goes to inactive state. This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: SLVBEIF

BitField.description: Slave Mode TX Under Run Interrupt Flag\nIn Slave mode, if TX underflow event occurs and the slave select line goes to inactive state, this interrupt flag will be set to 1.\nNote: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
BitField.name: SLVURIF

BitField.description:
TX Underflow Interrupt Flag
When the TX underflow event occurs, this bit will be set to 1, the state of data output pin depends on the setting of TXUFPOL.
Note 1: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: If reset slave's transmission circuit when slave selection signal is active, this flag will be set to 1 after 2 peripheral clock cycles + 3 system clock cycles since the reset operation is done.
BitField.name: TXUFIF

BitField.description: TX or RX Reset Status (Read Only)\nNote: Both the reset operations of TXRST and RXRST need 3 system clock cycles + 2 peripheral clock cycles. User can check the status of this bit to monitor the reset function is doing or done.
BitField.name: TXRXRST

BitField.description: Receive FIFO Data Count (Read Only)\nThis bit field indicates the valid data count of receive FIFO buffer.
BitField.name: RXCNT

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Data Count (Read Only)\nThis bit field indicates the valid data count of transmit FIFO buffer.
BitField.name: TXCNT

BitField.description:
Effective Bit Number of Uncompleted RX data
This status register indicates that effective bit number of uncompleted RX data when SLVBERX (SPIx_FIFOCTL[10]) is enabled and RX bit count error event happen in SPI Slave mode. (SPI Slave mode only)
This status register will be fixed to 0x0 when SLVBERX (SPIx_FIFOCTL[10]) is disabled.
Note: This register will be cleared to 0x0 when user writes 0x1 to SLVBEIF (SPIx_STATUS[6]).
BitField.name: SLVBENUM

BitField.description:
Data Transmit Register
The data transmit registers pass through the transmitted data into the 4-level transmit FIFO buffers. The number of valid bits depends on the setting of DWIDTH (SPIx_CTL[12:8]) in SPI mode or WDWIDTH (SPIx_I2SCTL[5:4]) in I2S mode.
In SPI mode, if DWIDTH is set to 0x08, the bits TX[7:0] will be transmitted. If DWIDTH is set to 0x00, the SPI controller will perform a 32-bit transfer.
In I2S mode, if WDWIDTH (SPIx_I2SCTL[5:4]) is set to 0x2, the data width of audio channel is 24-bit and corresponding to TX[23:0]. If WDWIDTH is set as 0x0, 0x1, or 0x3, all bits of this field are valid and referred to the data arrangement in I2S mode FIFO operation section
Note: In Master mode, SPI controller will start to transfer the SPI bus clock after 1 APB clock and 6 peripheral clock cycles after user writes to this register.
BitField.name: TX

BitField.description: Data Receive Register (Read Only)\nThere are 4-level FIFO buffers in this controller. The data receive register holds the data received from SPI data input pin. If the RXEMPTY (SPIx_STATUS[8] or SPIx_I2SSTS[8]) is not set to 1, the receive FIFO buffers can be accessed through software by reading this register.
BitField.name: RX

BitField.description: I2S Controller Enable Bit\nNote 1: If enabling this bit, I2Sx_BCLK will start to output in Master mode.\nNote 2: Before changing the configurations of SPIx_I2SCTL, SPIx_I2SCLK, and SPIx_FIFOCTL registers, user shall clear the I2SEN (SPIx_I2SCTL[0]) and confirm the I2SENSTS (SPIx_I2SSTS[15]) is 0.
BitField.name: I2SEN

BitField.description: Slave Mode\nI2S can operate as master or slave. For Master mode, I2Sx_BCLK and I2Sx_LRCLK pins are output mode and send bit clock from this chip to audio CODEC chip. In Slave mode, I2Sx_BCLK and I2Sx_LRCLK pins are input mode and I2Sx_BCLK and I2Sx_LRCLK signals are received from outer audio CODEC chip.
BitField.name: SLAVE

BitField.description: Master Clock Enable Bit\nIf MCLKEN is set to 1, I2S controller will generate master clock on SPIx_I2SMCLK pin for external audio devices.

BitField.description: Right Channel Zero Cross Detection Enable Bit\nIf this bit is set to 1, when right channel data sign bit change or next shift data bits are all 0 then RZCIF flag in SPIx_I2SSTS register is set to 1. This function is only available in transmit operation.

BitField.description: Left Channel Zero Cross Detection Enable Bit\nIf this bit is set to 1, when left channel data sign bit changes or next shift data bits are all 0 then LZCIF flag in SPIx_I2SSTS register is set to 1. This function is only available in transmit operation.

BitField.name: LZCIEN

BitField.name: RXTH

BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Threshold\nIf the valid data count of the transmit FIFO buffer is less than or equal to the TXTH setting, the TXTHIF bit will be set to 1, else the TXTHIF bit will be cleared to 0. The MSB of this bit field is only meaningful while SPI mode 4~16 bits of data length.

Therefore the SPI transfer done events of TX/RX operations can be obtained at correct timing point.

This status register will be fixed to 0x0 when SLVBERX (SPIx_FIFOCTL[10]) is disabled.
Note: This register will be cleared to 0x0 when user writes 0x1 to SLVBEIF (SPIx_STATUS[6]).
BitField.name: SLVBENUM

BitField.description:
Data Transmit Register
The data transmit registers pass through the transmitted data into the 4-level transmit FIFO buffers. The number of valid bits depends on the setting of DWIDTH (SPIx_CTL[12:8]) in SPI mode or WDWIDTH (SPIx_I2SCTL[5:4]) in I2S mode.
In SPI mode, if DWIDTH is set to 0x08, the bits TX[7:0] will be transmitted. If DWIDTH is set to 0x00, the SPI controller will perform a 32-bit transfer.
In I2S mode, if WDWIDTH (SPIx_I2SCTL[5:4]) is set to 0x2, the data width of audio channel is 24-bit and corresponding to TX[23:0]. If WDWIDTH is set as 0x0, 0x1, or 0x3, all bits of this field are valid and referred to the data arrangement in I2S mode FIFO operation section
Note: In Master mode, SPI controller will start to transfer the SPI bus clock after 1 APB clock and 6 peripheral clock cycles after user writes to this register.
BitField.name: TX

BitField.description: Data Receive Register (Read Only)\nThere are 4-level FIFO buffers in this controller. The data receive register holds the data received from SPI data input pin.  (SUSPITV[3:0] + 0.5) * period of QSPI_CLK clock cycle
